upsert.title: Codex x TwitchCon Hackathon 2026
upsert.summary: Build a Twitch-connected project (API, EventSub, chat, Extensions or overlays) using OpenAI Codex. Top five present live at TwitchCon San Diego on 15 Nov.
upsert.eligibility: Individuals and teams aged 18+ (or age of majority); companies and professional organisations excluded; Brazil, Quebec, Russia, Crimea, Cuba, Iran, North Korea and other sanctioned places excluded.

prize.description: US$25,000 cash: 1st US$10,000, 2nd US$6,000, 3rd US$4,000, two runners-up US$2,500 each.

notes: Project must be newly built in the submission period. Needs repo link, public demo video up to 3 min and Codex session ID.

upsert.title: UGREEN Hackathon 2026: Build AI Skills for a NAS
upsert.summary: Online hackathon to build AI Skills for a NAS across four tracks. Round 1 needs a proposal of up to 500 words plus a test Skill; no NAS needed to enter.
upsert.eligibility: Individuals of legal age or teams of up to 3, from countries in the official rules; organisations cannot enter; Brazil, China and Quebec excluded.

prize.description: US$46,000 cash: 1st US$20,000, 2nd US$10,000, 3rd US$6,000, two Most Creative awards US$5,000 each.

notes: Up to 30 finalists announced 21 Nov; final Skills and demo videos due 30 Nov.

upsert.title: DSH Hacks V2

organizer.name: DeltaForge Hacks, NXT Horizon and STEMise AI

upsert.summary: Student-run online hackathon on AI and healthcare, with cash prizes, sponsor credits and a research-oriented award run with YRI.
upsert.eligibility: Students aged 13+; companies and professional organisations cannot enter; open to all countries with standard exceptions in the rules.

prize.description: US$42,234 pool incl. credits: top three cash US$3,928 / US$3,543 / US$3,363, 100 x US$299 Tin Computer credits, and US$1,500 plus scholarship for best research project.

notes: Most of the headline pool is credits; cash is the three top prizes plus the research award.

upsert.title: BCH BLAZE 2026 Hackathon
upsert.summary: Bitcoin Cash hackathon with a Mainnet track (live demo, WizardConnect integration), a Media track and community awards. Prizes paid on BCH mainnet.
upsert.deadlineLabel: Registration closes (timezone not stated); submissions 14-22 Nov
upsert.eligibility: Open to developers worldwide, solo or teams of 2-4; at least one team member must attend a BLAZE preparation stream.

prize.description: US$8,000+ (25 BCH): Mainnet 1st US$3,500, 2nd US$1,500, 3rd US$750; Media US$1,000; Community Choice US$750; TokenHunt US$250.

notes: Winners announced 28 Nov. Paid in PUSD, BLISS NFTs, BCH or CashTokens.

upsert.title: Dev3pack Global Hackathon 2026
upsert.summary: Solana university hackathon (27-29 Nov), online or at local build stations, preceded by a free Solana Rust bootcamp. Top teams invited to the Bridge Accelerator.
upsert.eligibility: University students worldwide, building in teams on Solana; projects must be open source.

prize.description: US$10,000+ for Best App Overall on Solana; Seeker phones for best mobile app; US$500 local tracks in selected countries.

notes: Registration and cutoff time not confirmed on the organiser's own page; verify before applying.

upsert.title: Mergetober 2026 with Cognee
upsert.summary: Open-source contribution contest: build or improve Cognee integrations for AI agent memory via merged pull requests, each paired with a short blog post.
upsert.eligibility: Open to anyone, anywhere, subject to local law and shipping limits. Individual entries only.

prize.description: Top contributor US$2,000 (cash, iPhone or MacBook); 20 random merged-PR contributors US$100 each. Headline pool US$5,000 but listed awards total US$4,000.

notes: Prize figures inconsistent on the listing; PRs must be opened in October.

upsert.title: Lablab x AMD AI Academy Challenge
upsert.summary: Online learn-build-share AI challenge run by lablab.ai with AMD and NativelyAI. Individual participation only.
upsert.eligibility: Individuals only; teams are not allowed.

prize.description: US$5,000 prize pool; individual prize amounts not published.
